profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Avant-garde Health
profile.summary:
Hello World! 👋🏻 
I'm a seasoned Software Engineer with over four years of professional experience. 
During my pursuit of a Master's degree in Computer Science at Northeastern University in Boston, I honed my skills through internships at renowned companies like Annaly Capital Management and Disney Streaming. 
Currently, I'm thriving in my role as a Software Engineer at Avant-garde Health, where I've been making impactful contributions for the past three years. 
I'm passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems and eager to collaborate and innovate in the ever-evolving landscape of Software Development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PySpark · Python · React.js · Flask · Django

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Developed a Cloud Infrastructure to persist test-specific data from E2E Commerce Tests by using AWS services such as DynamoDB, Kinesis Stream, S3 bucket, Lambda, and Redshift Database.

Integrated data from E2E Commerce Tests to Dashboard and enhanced UX by adding bar-charts by using Angular and Material Design library.

Created AWS Lambda function to parse XML documents from ~7k notifications/minute and extract transaction data and update the taxation data stored in DynamoDB.

Integrated AWS Lambda function with Taxation Service Cloud Infrastructure which filters data by each Latin American country and sends an appropriate response to Amazon SQS.

Developed the infrastructure for testing the tax settlement process by setting up an Amazon SQS Queue as trigger for AWS Lambda function.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted a class of over 50 students for CS 5500 Fundamentals of Software Engineering by conducting regular office hours and guiding them with their Assignments.

Assisted 2 teams with their project as their mentor and participated in their Sprint Planning and monitored the progress and helped them to set up the environments for a proper Software Development process

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Automated a system that would retrieve the Vendors whose renewal date is due in near future and issue a JIRA ticket to the Relationship Owner pertaining to the information of the Vendor for Vendor Renewal Process using JIRA Rest API.

Designed and Implemented a cross-platform Desktop App and Web App for various utilities such as Health Check Monitoring System, rolling Future Commission Merchant data on a monthly basis, etc. using ElectronJS and ReactJS.

Developed a wrapper for DevExpress React Grid and documented it on the internal Confluence page which would allow developers to inherit the Grid and implement various features such as CRUD operations, sorting, filtering, etc.

Integrated an Authentication web service to the same Application through which User Permission for each section under the App was managed and the whole workflow was implemented for rolling Future Commission Merchant data.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted a class of around 120 students to understand concepts of CS 5610 Web Development such as ReactJS, Redux, Sprint Boot, NodeJs, jQuery, Angular etc. and graded their Assignments

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of 3 and devised a system to help clients manage fleet of vehicles leveraging an OBD device to retrieve data from vehicle and displaying data on a web platform utilizing Odoo ERP.

Developed Hospital Management ERP using Python, JavaScript and XML to capture necessary information used in analysis and further study.

Modified open source ERP & removed bugs from existing system using Python and PostgreSQL making the ERP efficient along with additional functionalities.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of 2 to develop the ERP for University Management by adapting the OpenEDUCAT ERP.
Removed bugs from the existing system and developed new modules using Python and PostgreSQL making the ERP efficient along with additional functionalities.

projects.title: Encoder/Decoder using Generic Tree
projects.description:
Designed generic trees based on composite patterns. The encoding and decoding mechanism is analogous to symbol -> code dictionary. This application supports only prefix coding schemes and the decoding process could be done with any number of encoding symbols.

The tree structure has the actual data at the leaf nodes and the intermediate nodes direct to the respective leaf node for the given encoded message.

This application supports the following functionalities:
1 ) Add a code-symbol pair to the coding tree
2) Take in an encoded message and decode it
3) Get the list of all the codes supported by this tree structure
4) Check if the tree is complete

projects.title: Freecell
projects.description:
Developed a Freecell game using the Builder Design Pattern in Java.
It is a console based game and the state of the deck would be displayed after each move.
Enhanced the controller of the game to support multiple Game Models.
The purpose of this project was to understand the MVC architecture in Java.
